exposure: maternal SARS-CoV-2 infection within 7 days of birth
outcome: therapeutic hypothermia for hypoxic ischaemic encephalopathy
cohort: The study participants were babies admitted to a neonatal unit in the UK following birth to a mother with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection within 7 days of birth.
finding: Babies born to mothers with SARS-CoV-2 infection around the time of birth accounted for a low proportion of total NNU admissions, neonatal SARS-CoV-2 was uncommon, and adverse neonatal conditions were more common in babies whose SARS-CoV-2-positive mothers required intensive care.
